playbooks.first_experiment: Run a bounded Top-3 account loop: evidence dossier -> Execution Diagnostic -> discovery plan -> customer-specific proposal draft.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Qualified problems and verified commercial movement per founder minute.
playbooks.expansion_path: Diagnostic -> 30-Day Revenue Command Pilot -> Command Room retainer -> AI Company OS setup -> repeated modules into Private SaaS.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Real buyer/workflow access; canonical offer authority; no invented intent, consent, cash or proof.

playbooks.first_experiment: Map one real tool-using AI workflow against governance, authorization, eval, resilience and third-party control gaps; produce remediation evidence pack.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Material control gaps with accountable owners closed and re-verified.
playbooks.expansion_path: Readiness -> control implementation -> managed governance/evals -> Policy Gateway / Agent Identity / AI Eval modules.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Named AI owner, tool/data/action boundaries, official Saudi requirements; never imply certification not held.

playbooks.first_experiment: Build a 10-account Saudi-entry cohort from verified expansion/procurement/partner signals; map buyer, route-to-market, partner gap and one lawful next action each.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Qualified market-entry/partner opportunities that progress to real conversations or commercial tests.
playbooks.expansion_path: Market Access Sprint -> Partner/Distributor Desk -> B2G/Supplier Readiness -> intelligence retainer -> Saudi Signal Feed / white-label channel.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Lawful buyer/partner route; supplier/tender status verified; no government-access or eligibility claims.

playbooks.first_experiment: Apply the leak taxonomy to Dealix plus one design account and produce quantified evidence gaps and next-best diagnostic questions.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Diagnostic -> qualified discovery conversion and time to actionable problem statement.
playbooks.expansion_path: Diagnostic -> Pilot -> reusable taxonomy -> Diagnostic Engine / white-label diagnostic.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Canonical commercial path and evidence-based problem framing; no public fixed-price drift.

playbooks.first_experiment: Instrument one inbound service queue across two channels; classify routing, SLA, handoff and quality failures before proposing automation.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Response/resolution SLA, qualified-conversation conversion and avoidable handoff/rework rate.
playbooks.expansion_path: CX diagnostic -> implementation -> managed CX command -> vertical CX command module.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Sufficient inbound volume, verified channel authority/consent, measurable operational consequence.

playbooks.first_experiment: Create a readiness scorecard for one bounded AI inventory using SDAIA/NCA evidence classes, then produce owner-assigned remediation actions.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Percentage of material AI risks/controls with owner, evidence and verified remediation state.
playbooks.expansion_path: Readiness -> remediation roadmap -> managed governance evidence -> corporate training / recurring control service.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: AI inventory and accountable owner; legal/certification claims remain outside Dealix unless independently proven.

playbooks.first_experiment: Model one operational data lifecycle: inventory -> purpose/authority -> processor -> retention -> DSAR/deletion evidence, with gaps surfaced.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Evidence coverage and cycle time for operational privacy/data requests.
playbooks.expansion_path: Data inventory -> managed evidence operations -> recurring PDPL/data desk -> governance module.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Lawful authority, provenance and role clarity; route legal interpretation to qualified counsel.

playbooks.first_experiment: Run a failure/eval/control assessment on one Dealix tool-using agent: identity, scope, tool authority, prompt injection, idempotency, approval and rollback.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Material failures detected before effect plus regression controls that remain green.
playbooks.expansion_path: Assessment -> eval harness -> recurring regression service -> AI Eval Service + Policy Gateway + Agent Identity Registry.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Real agent/action surface and isolated test environment; no weakening of approval boundaries.

playbooks.first_experiment: Generate weekly proof packs for Dealix and one bounded delivery workflow; separate activity, capability, runtime, delivery and outcome evidence.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Decision-relevant proof coverage and percentage of claims traceable to source evidence.
playbooks.expansion_path: Weekly pack -> monthly executive proof retainer -> reusable Proof Ledger schema -> Proof Ledger API.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Canonical Proof Ledger and customer-safe evidence; outcome/public proof requires matching permission.

playbooks.first_experiment: Run a weekly CEO command cycle on live Dealix operating data: Top-5 decisions, blocked evidence, economics, approvals and owner follow-through.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Founder minutes per verified decision/movement and closure rate of high-value actions.
playbooks.expansion_path: Internal command -> customer retainer -> multi-client operating model -> Private Dealix SaaS command layer.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Live operating data and action loop; must not degrade into generic advisory.

playbooks.first_experiment: Normalize 30 fresh official Saudi signals into source, entity, event, implication, buyer, confidence and next-action fields; rank by economic relevance.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Share of signals that create a qualified decision, account hypothesis or commercial action.
playbooks.expansion_path: Analyst brief -> subscription -> enterprise feed -> Saudi Signal Feed API / Benchmark products.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Lawful public sources, provenance, freshness and anti-duplication; news aggregation alone is insufficient.

playbooks.first_experiment: Monitor a bounded set of public opportunities and produce Fit / No-Bid / Partner-Needed decision packs without submitting anything.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Precision of actionable opportunities and avoided low-fit bid effort.
playbooks.expansion_path: Monitoring -> Bid/No-Bid packs -> intelligence retainer -> partner-route packs.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Customer qualification/procurement capability and verified supplier/tender state; tender submission remains L5.

playbooks.first_experiment: Produce three sample action briefs from fresh SDAIA/NCA/CST/DGA changes, each translating official change -> affected workflow -> evidence -> action; seek feedback only through warm/authorized routes.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Buyer-rated action utility and repeat usage, not article volume.
playbooks.expansion_path: Action brief -> annual subscription -> benchmark/training/governance cross-sell.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Reliable official change feed and real buyer feedback; must add operational translation beyond free news.

playbooks.first_experiment: Baseline one AI workload across model cost, latency, success quality, retry/tool cost and task value; simulate routing alternatives.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Cost per successful business task at required quality/latency.
playbooks.expansion_path: Assessment -> managed model economics -> routing optimization -> reusable router/economics capability.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Task-level telemetry and quality baseline; avoid cost cuts that lower business success.

playbooks.first_experiment: Instrument one business-critical connector path for retries, duplicate effects, latency, dead letters and recovery; produce exact-once improvement backlog.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Failure/duplicate rate, MTTR and business-impact minutes avoided.
playbooks.expansion_path: Reliability audit -> managed connector ops -> reusable reliability module within Company OS/SaaS.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Observable business-critical connector and safe test path; preserve one canonical connector bus.

playbooks.first_experiment: Build an applicability/readiness pack for representative Wave-affected profiles: required fields, integration states, exceptions and reconciliation evidence.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Correct applicability classification and reduction in unresolved integration/reconciliation exceptions.
playbooks.expansion_path: Readiness -> implementation partner handoff -> managed exception/reconciliation operations.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Verify taxpayer cohort/wave and technical scope; tax/legal certification stays with qualified authority.

playbooks.first_experiment: Select one non-safety-critical brownfield workflow such as maintenance admin, quality evidence or supplier exception handling; quantify current rework/cycle time.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Cycle-time/rework reduction and proof of economic feasibility.
playbooks.expansion_path: Digital readiness -> bounded integration -> managed ops/proof -> vertical factory playbook.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Accessible data and commercially proven tech; critical OT/control requires qualified specialist partner.

playbooks.first_experiment: Map one exception journey across order/warehouse/field-service/customer systems; measure aging, handoffs, rework and customer consequence.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Exception aging, SLA breach rate and avoidable rework/customer impact.
playbooks.expansion_path: Exception diagnostic -> managed evidence command -> repeatable logistics vertical module.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Operational data access and measurable exception economics.

playbooks.first_experiment: Build one workload readiness/evidence matrix covering architecture, tenant/data boundary, reliability, cost, cloud controls and operational proof.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Readiness/evidence completeness plus reliability and cost improvement on named workload.
playbooks.expansion_path: Readiness -> managed reliability/FinOps/evidence ops -> SaaS tenant-readiness module.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Named workload/target architecture, Production Trust and NCA/CST cloud evidence; no commodity hosting resale.

playbooks.first_experiment: Map 20 Saudi/foreign partner candidates to specific Dealix capability, access or delivery gaps; score reciprocal value, customer overlap and delivery credibility.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Qualified reciprocal partner routes that create customer/revenue/delivery leverage.
playbooks.expansion_path: Partner discovery -> referral/co-delivery -> channel retainer -> White-Label Dealix Modules.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Specific mutual value and governed economics; reject logo-collecting partnerships.

playbooks.first_experiment: Create a branch-command diagnostic for one franchise design partner: branch revenue/CX/ops variance, exceptions and management actions.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Cross-branch variance converted into measurable corrective actions.
playbooks.expansion_path: Diagnostic -> managed multi-branch command -> benchmark subscription / vertical module.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: One real multi-branch design partner and repeated cross-branch decision problem.

playbooks.first_experiment: Diagnose one e-commerce support/order journey: pre-sale question -> order -> exception -> return/refund -> retention; quantify leakage without changing payment authority.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Qualified conversion/retention movement, exception resolution and repeat-contact reduction.
playbooks.expansion_path: CX leak diagnostic -> support/retention command -> managed proof ops -> vertical SaaS module.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Enough order/support volume, lawful customer-data access and positive unit economics.

playbooks.first_experiment: Build a partner-first Open Banking lab/readiness pack for one permitted use case: API/data-flow map, consent, failure states and conformance evidence; no regulated service representation.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Conformance/evidence gaps identified and partner-approved integration readiness.
playbooks.expansion_path: Readiness pack -> licensed-partner integration -> managed exception/evidence operations.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Licensed/SAMA-supervised partner and sandbox/lab scope; Dealix does not act as a licensed Open Banking provider.

playbooks.first_experiment: With a qualified health-tech/operator partner, map one explicitly non-clinical administrative workflow and its interoperability/exception evidence.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Administrative cycle time, integration exception rate and evidence completeness.
playbooks.expansion_path: Workflow diagnostic -> partner-led implementation -> managed administrative/interoperability ops module.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Qualified healthcare partner, non-clinical scope, privacy/security authority and sandbox/validation where applicable.

playbooks.first_experiment: Map one lead-to-deal or tenant/service journey for a property operator; quantify follow-up leakage, handoffs, response times and service exceptions.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Qualified lead movement, response-cycle reduction and service SLA improvement.
playbooks.expansion_path: Revenue/ops diagnostic -> managed property command -> reusable vertical module.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Accessible workflow data and measurable leakage; avoid positioning as a generic CRM replacement.

playbooks.first_experiment: Choose one operator workflow - B2B sales, group/event sales or guest-service exceptions - and quantify missed follow-up, SLA and revenue/service impact.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Qualified booking/revenue movement or service-exception cycle-time improvement.
playbooks.expansion_path: Diagnostic -> managed tourism/hospitality command -> vertical playbook/module.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Operator data access, repeatable workflow and economics beyond commodity guest messaging.

playbooks.first_experiment: Diagnose one B2B sales/admissions/service workflow for a training or education provider; separate acquisition, service and outcome evidence.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Inquiry -> qualified meeting/enrollment movement and service/outcome evidence quality.
playbooks.expansion_path: Diagnostic -> managed education command -> repeatable vertical module / Proof Pack.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Sufficient ACV and repeatable workflow; avoid low-ticket B2C economics with high support burden.

playbooks.first_experiment: Build a control-to-evidence matrix for Dealix or a willing private-sector design partner using NCA controls; identify evidence owner, freshness and remediation gaps.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Material controls with current evidence and owner, plus remediation closure rate.
playbooks.expansion_path: Evidence matrix -> recurring evidence operations -> AI/cloud governance cross-sell.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Operational evidence scope; penetration testing, SOC/certification and legal assurance require qualified specialists.

playbooks.first_experiment: After real deliveries, map repeated workflows/modules across 2-3 customers and prove tenant, identity, audit, entitlement and data-isolation requirements before product build.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Workflow similarity, repeatable value and tenant-safe readiness across real customers.
playbooks.expansion_path: Design-partner private subscription -> multi-tenant private SaaS -> enterprise license.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Sustained Production Trust plus 2-3 repeated customer workflows and tenant-safe foundations.

playbooks.first_experiment: Stabilize the internal Opportunity Graph contract and test it against at least two distinct internal/partner consumers before externalizing any API.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Semantic stability, consumer reuse and low contract-breaking change rate.
playbooks.expansion_path: Internal contract -> partner integration -> metered/private Opportunity Graph API.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Stable canonical graph semantics, provenance rules and repeated external integration demand.

playbooks.first_experiment: Prototype one proof import/export schema across two different delivery workflows and verify claim/evidence/permission separation remains intact.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Cross-workflow schema reuse and percentage of claims traceable to evidence/permission state.
playbooks.expansion_path: Internal proof service -> partner export/import -> private Proof Ledger API.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Repeated proof ingestion/export need and stable evidence semantics.

playbooks.first_experiment: Prototype policy decisions for existing Dealix material-action gates: ALLOW / DENY / REQUIRE_APPROVAL with subject, action hash, scope, expiry and evidence.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Correct policy decisions, zero unauthorized material effects and auditable approval coverage.
playbooks.expansion_path: Internal Approval Center policy -> private service -> enterprise Policy/Approval Gateway API.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Stable enterprise auth/identity model and repeated policy decisions; do not create a competing approval authority.

playbooks.first_experiment: Add explicit identity metadata for the five canonical agents and their material action classes: owner, tenant, scope, budget, expiry, authority source and audit link.
playbooks.primary_kpi: 100% of material agent actions attributable to a unique identity, owner and authority record.
playbooks.expansion_path: Internal identity contract -> multi-tenant governance module -> enterprise Agent Identity Registry.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Multiple governed agents/actions and tenant/authority model; no sixth permanent agent.

playbooks.first_experiment: Normalize a bounded public Saudi signal set into a stable schema with source rights, timestamps, provenance, dedupe and confidence; test one internal consumer.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Freshness, provenance coverage, dedupe accuracy and consumer action rate.
playbooks.expansion_path: Internal signal feed -> enterprise feed -> metered API only when rights and paying demand are proven.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Lawful source rights/provenance and stable normalized schema; no personal-data reuse without authority.

playbooks.first_experiment: Standardize the best-performing diagnostic questions, evidence taxonomy, scoring and output from at least three repeated diagnostic patterns.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Diagnostic consistency, time-to-output and discovery/action conversion.
playbooks.expansion_path: Internal engine -> embedded module -> white-label diagnostic / private API.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Three or more repeated diagnostics with proven decision/conversion value.

playbooks.first_experiment: Generate proposal/decision packs strictly from discovery and quote authority for repeated cases; measure factual consistency, approval friction and production time.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Proposal production time, factual/authority accuracy and quote-to-decision movement.
playbooks.expansion_path: Internal pack -> software module -> partner/white-label license.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Repeated proposal workflow, stable commercial truth and evidence/approval boundaries.

playbooks.first_experiment: Build a recurring eval corpus from canonical Dealix agent failures and acceptance tests; score task success, unsafe action attempts, hallucinated state and regression.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Regression detection rate and task-success/safety score on a stable eval corpus.
playbooks.expansion_path: Internal eval harness -> managed eval service -> private eval platform/module.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Recurring real test corpus, decision owner and production-observability evidence.

playbooks.first_experiment: Extract 10 reusable customer-safe templates/playbooks from proven Dealix delivery and label source, evidence class, permissions and version.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Reuse rate and operator time saved without loss of quality or truth.
playbooks.expansion_path: Internal vault -> licensed bundle/subscription -> partner enablement IP.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Proven operating provenance and customer-safe/permission-safe IP.

playbooks.first_experiment: Turn one proven operating playbook into an internal corporate-training module, then validate learning transfer with a design partner before selling broadly.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Skill adoption, workflow quality improvement and repeat training demand.
playbooks.expansion_path: Internal training -> corporate workshop -> cohort/recorded course -> curriculum license.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Repeatable methodology, customer proof and real training demand; avoid generic AI education.

playbooks.first_experiment: Define one white-label module candidate from proven Delivery/SaaS IP and test partner economics, support boundaries, branding, data ownership and revenue share.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Partner-sourced qualified demand, contribution margin and support burden.
playbooks.expansion_path: Partner pilot -> license/revenue share -> multi-partner module distribution.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Proven module, partner customer pull, support model and economics that preserve Dealix control/margin.

playbooks.first_experiment: Publish internally one benchmark sample using public/permission-safe comparable data; test whether executives use it to make a concrete decision before monetization.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Decision utility, repeat request rate and paid/enterprise demand.
playbooks.expansion_path: Sample -> paid report -> recurring benchmark subscription -> enterprise benchmark pack.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Sufficient sample, provenance, comparability and permission-safe aggregation.

playbooks.first_experiment: No commercial experiment. Maintain a rights/provenance/privacy checklist and candidate-dataset inventory only.
playbooks.primary_kpi: No launch KPI until explicit source rights, privacy authority and demand are proven.
playbooks.expansion_path: Rights cleared -> bounded dataset product -> license only after legal/privacy/provenance review.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Explicit source rights, provenance, privacy review and customer demand. Remains blocked otherwise.

playbooks.first_experiment: After Dealix reaches positive operating cash flow, build an acquisition scorecard and screen a bounded set of micro-SaaS assets for customer overlap, retention, margin and integration fit.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Strategic fit, durable ARR quality, payback and post-acquisition integration leverage.
playbooks.expansion_path: Scout -> diligence -> acquisition -> cross-sell/IP integration -> optional roll-up.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Positive cash flow, explicit acquisition budget, integration capacity and no distraction from core cash/proof.

playbooks.first_experiment: Continuously cluster repeated customer/internal problems that do not fit core product; only open a bounded venture experiment when evidence supports a standalone opportunity.
playbooks.primary_kpi: Repeated independent demand signals, validated willingness to pay and low founder-attention cost.
playbooks.expansion_path: Bounded experiment -> product/license -> spinout only when standalone economics are proven.
playbooks.strategic_dependency: Repeated opportunity evidence, founder capacity and clear separation from core product; no idea-first venture creation.
